_about: B-91 Scenes test page (/scenes). The REVIEWED part of each scene: the story, the question, the source label and the expectations. Each expectation is written from the scene's inputs (data/scenes/scenes_data.json, built from the fixtures) and official guidance - never copied from VEDA's output - with its reason and source, and a check that app/scenes.py runs against the REAL run output. Do not edit an expectation to make a failing check pass without asking (Cowork).

_bands.en: JPS river level bands: Normal; Waspada (Alert) - be alert; Amaran (Warning) - get ready to move; Bahaya (Danger) - move if told. VEDA's levels follow them: Alert = Keep watching, Warning = Get ready, Danger = Act now.
_bands.ms: Tahap paras sungai JPS: Normal; Waspada - berwaspada; Amaran - bersedia untuk berpindah; Bahaya - berpindah jika diarahkan. Tahap VEDA mengikutnya: Waspada = Terus berjaga-jaga, Amaran = Bersedia, Bahaya = Bertindak sekarang.

based_on.en: Based on the Kelantan flood of November 2024

story.en: Tuesday 26 November 2024, 6 pm. It has rained hard since the morning, here and across the border in Thailand. A family near the Sg. Golok in Rantau Panjang wants to know if they should get ready tonight.
story.ms: Selasa, 26 November 2024, 6 petang. Hujan lebat sejak pagi, di sini dan di seberang sempadan di Thailand. Sebuah keluarga berhampiran Sg. Golok di Rantau Panjang mahu tahu sama ada mereka perlu bersedia malam ini.

reason.en: The river at Rantau Panjang is above the Warning line (8 m) and below Danger (9 m).
reason.ms: Sungai di Rantau Panjang melepasi garis Amaran (8 m) dan di bawah Bahaya (9 m).

text.en: The upstream reading at Kg. Jenob is left out.
text.ms: Bacaan hulu di Kg. Jenob diketepikan.

reason.en: Its newest reading is 3.5 hours old - too old to say what the river is doing now.
reason.ms: Bacaan terbarunya berusia 3.5 jam - terlalu lama untuk menunjukkan keadaan sungai sekarang.

source.en: VEDA rule: an old reading is never used as 'now'
source.ms: Peraturan VEDA: bacaan lama tidak digunakan sebagai 'sekarang'

text.en: The heavy rain in Thailand, upstream, is taken into account.
text.ms: Hujan lebat di Thailand, di hulu, diambil kira.

reason.en: About 100 mm fell upstream in 3 days; that water flows down the Sg. Golok to Rantau Panjang.
reason.ms: Kira-kira 100 mm hujan turun di hulu dalam 3 hari; air itu mengalir turun Sg. Golok ke Rantau Panjang.

source.en: Open-Meteo rain archive; VEDA rain rule
source.ms: Arkib hujan Open-Meteo; peraturan hujan VEDA

based_on.en: Based on the Kelantan flood of November 2024

story.en: Wednesday 27 November 2024, 8 am. After a night of rain, the same family checks again before work. No new river reading has been reported since yesterday evening.
story.ms: Rabu, 27 November 2024, 8 pagi. Selepas hujan sepanjang malam, keluarga yang sama menyemak semula sebelum keluar bekerja. Tiada bacaan sungai baharu dilaporkan sejak petang semalam.

reason.ms: Bacaan sungai bandar ini sudah berusia 14 jam. VEDA tidak boleh meneka berdasarkannya.

story.en: Wednesday 27 November 2024, 7:30 pm. A fresh river reading has just been reported. The family's relatives in Kota Bharu ask whether they should leave Rantau Panjang now.
story.ms: Rabu, 27 November 2024, 7:30 malam. Bacaan sungai baharu baru sahaja dilaporkan. Saudara-mara keluarga itu di Kota Bharu bertanya sama ada mereka patut meninggalkan Rantau Panjang sekarang.

reason.en: The river is almost 2 m above the Danger line (9 m) and still rising.

text.en: The answer passes the safety gate.

reason.en: An Act now answer must give safe steps only - never tell anyone to go into floodwater.
reason.ms: Jawapan Bertindak sekarang mesti memberi langkah selamat sahaja - tidak pernah menyuruh sesiapa meredah air banjir.

story.en: A dry Saturday morning in June, 10 am. A grandmother in Tumpat hears flood talk on WhatsApp and asks if there is anything to worry about.
story.ms: Pagi Sabtu yang kering pada bulan Jun, 10 pagi. Seorang nenek di Tumpat terdengar cerita banjir di WhatsApp dan bertanya sama ada ada apa-apa yang perlu dirisaukan.

reason.en: Both of Tumpat's river level posts are well below their Alert lines and not changing.
reason.ms: Kedua-dua tiang paras sungai Tumpat jauh di bawah garis Waspada dan tidak berubah.

text.en: Both of Tumpat's river level posts are used.
text.ms: Kedua-dua tiang paras sungai Tumpat digunakan.

reason.en: Tumpat sits where two rivers meet the sea, so it needs both readings.
reason.ms: Tumpat terletak di pertemuan dua sungai dengan laut, jadi ia memerlukan kedua-dua bacaan.

source.en: VEDA's gauge list for Tumpat (tentative, expert review pending)

story.en: A wet evening in late November, 6 pm. The river in Kota Bharu has been creeping up all afternoon. A shop owner near the river asks whether to move stock tonight.
story.ms: Petang yang basah pada akhir November, 6 petang. Sungai di Kota Bharu naik perlahan-lahan sepanjang petang. Seorang pemilik kedai berhampiran sungai bertanya sama ada perlu memindahkan barang malam ini.

reason.en: The river at Kota Bharu is above the Alert line (3 m) but below Warning (4 m).
reason.ms: Sungai di Kota Bharu melepasi garis Waspada (3 m) tetapi di bawah Amaran (4 m).

reason.en: The river is above its Alert line and rising.

story.en: A Saturday in June, 10 am. Pasir Mas looks calm, but two river level posts upstream stopped sending readings early this morning. A teacher asks if it is safe to hold a school event by the river.
story.ms: Hari Sabtu pada bulan Jun, 10 pagi. Pasir Mas kelihatan tenang, tetapi dua tiang paras sungai di hulu berhenti menghantar bacaan awal pagi tadi. Seorang guru bertanya sama ada selamat untuk mengadakan acara sekolah di tepi sungai.

text.en: The Critic notices the silent upstream posts and asks the Data agent for another one.

reason.en: Their newest readings are 6 hours old, so VEDA cannot see what is coming down the river.

story.en: Midday in late November. The river in Kota Bharu is still low, but it is raining hard in town and it has rained heavily upstream for three days. A father asks if his family should get ready.
story.ms: Tengah hari pada akhir November. Sungai di Kota Bharu masih rendah, tetapi hujan lebat di bandar dan hujan lebat di hulu sejak tiga hari. Seorang bapa bertanya sama ada keluarganya perlu bersedia.

text.en: Level: Keep watching or Get ready - not Normal.

reason.en: The river is low now, but heavy rain upstream for three days and heavy rain in town can raise it within hours.
